017package org.apache.juneau.server.config.repository;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.config.*;
025
026/**
027 * Command that fetches configuration from a Git repository for a given project and branch.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Clones or pulls the configured Git repo, then loads application and project-specific
031 * configuration files into a map of {@link ConfigItem} values.
032 */
033public class GetConfiguration implements Command, GetValue<Map<String,ConfigItem>> {
034
035   private static final String APPLICATION = "APPLICATION";
036   private static final String PROJECT = "PROJECT";
037   private static final String EXT = ".cfg";
038
039   // Serializes pull/checkout/pull on the single shared checkout so concurrent requests cannot interleave branches.
040   private static final Object GIT_LOCK = new Object();
041
042   // Remote pulls are throttled: at most one fetch per interval (settable as [GitServer] pullInterval, in seconds).
043   private static final long DEFAULT_PULL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60;
044   private static final long MIN_PULL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 1;
045
046   // Upper bound on the size of a single configuration file read from the repository.
047   static final long MAX_CONFIG_FILE_BYTES = 1024L * 1024L;
048   private static long lastPullNanos;
049   private static boolean pulledOnce;
050
051   private final Map<String,ConfigItem> configs = new HashMap<>();
052
053   @SuppressWarnings({
054      "java:S1845" // Field name intentionally differs only by case from static field PROJECT
055   })
056   private String project;
057   private final String branch;
058
059   /**
060    * Constructor.
061    *
062    * @param project Project name.
063    * @param branch Branch name.
064    */
065   public GetConfiguration(String project, String branch) {
066      // Path variables are URL-decoded after the path is split, so an encoded '%2F' or '..' can survive (CWE-22).
067      validateProject(project);
068      BranchNames.validate(branch);
069      this.branch = branch;
070      this.project = project;
071   }
072
073   /** {@inheritDoc} */
074   @Override
075   public void execute() throws Exception {
076
077      String pathStr;
078      String git;
079      long pullInterval;
080      var config = Config.create().name("juneau-server-config.cfg").build();
081      try {
082         pathStr = config.get("GitServer/pathLocal").orElse(null);
083         git = config.get("GitServer/gitRemote").orElse(null);
084         pullInterval = clampPullInterval(config.get("GitServer/pullInterval").asLong().orElse(DEFAULT_PULL_INTERVAL_SECONDS));
085      } finally {
086         config.close();
087      }
088
089      // Fail fast with a clear message when the operator has not configured the local checkout directory,
090      // rather than surfacing an opaque NullPointerException from new File(null) below.
091      if (pathStr == null)
092         throw new IllegalStateException("Required configuration 'GitServer/pathLocal' is not set.");
093
094      // Trusted operator-configured local git checkout directory (GitServer/pathLocal).
095      // Used to decide whether the repository must be cloned.
096      var root = new File(pathStr);
097
098      var fileDefaultStr = lcr(APPLICATION).concat(EXT);
099      var fileProjectStr = this.project.concat(EXT);
100
101      // The checkout is shared, so the git operations AND the object reads happen under one lock
102      // (otherwise concurrent requests could interleave fetches).
103      synchronized (GIT_LOCK) {
104         try (var gitControl = new GitControl(pathStr, git)) {
105
106            var now = System.nanoTime();
107            var due = ! pulledOnce || now - lastPullNanos >= pullInterval * 1_000_000_000L;
108            if (! root.isDirectory()) {
109               gitControl.cloneRepo();
110               pulledOnce = true;
111               lastPullNanos = now;
112            } else if (due) {
113               gitControl.fetchFromRepo();
114               pulledOnce = true;
115               lastPullNanos = now;
116            }
117
118            // The files are read from the object database at the branch tip, so the shared working checkout is never switched or read.
119            readFiles(gitControl, fileDefaultStr, fileProjectStr);
120         }
121      }
122   }
123
124   private void readFiles(GitControl gitControl, String fileDefaultStr, String fileProjectStr) throws IOException {
125      var lines = gitControl.readBlob(branch, fileDefaultStr, MAX_CONFIG_FILE_BYTES);
126      if (lines != null)
127         configs.put(APPLICATION, new ConfigItem(lines));
128
129      var linesProject = gitControl.readBlob(branch, fileProjectStr, MAX_CONFIG_FILE_BYTES);
130      if (linesProject != null)
131         configs.put(PROJECT, new ConfigItem(linesProject));
132   }
133
134   static long clampPullInterval(long seconds) {
135      return Math.max(seconds, MIN_PULL_INTERVAL_SECONDS);
136   }
137
138   /** {@inheritDoc} */
139   @Override
140   public Map<String,ConfigItem> get() {
141      return Map.copyOf(configs);
142   }
143
144   // Project becomes a file name, so no separators at all.
145   private static void validateProject(String value) {
146      if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.startsWith("-") || value.contains("\\") || value.contains("..") || value.indexOf('\0') >= 0 || value.contains("/"))
147         throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid project value.");
148   }
149}
